summary: Easy MT5 Connect Phase 1 regression (iter243) — backend + frontend both fully green. Unit lane: cd /app/backend && DB_NAME=ai_trading_bot_test python -m pytest tests/unit -q → 1077 passed in ~20s. Live-preview HTTP suite (new file /app/tests/test_easy_connect_p1_live.py, 5/5 passing): (1) GET /api/ea-script and /api/ea-script?v=1.61 both return EA 1.61 source with '#define EA_CLIENT_VERSION "1.61"', 'string ResolveServerUrl', 'ea_self_check', default input line 'input string ServerUrl              = "https://www.stoicaibot.com"', and NO 'ServerUrl + "' occurrence (every request routes through g_server_url). (2) GET /api/setup/installer.ps1 returns PowerShell v1.5 with $InstallerVersion = "1.5", Get-StoicRunningTerminal, STOIC-Server.txt, stoic.set, stoic-start.ini, Restart-StoicTerminal, and SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12. (3) POST /api/setup/pairing-token (authenticated, CSRF header on) returns ttl_minutes == 60 with expires_at ~60min in the future; re-issuing invalidates the prior outstanding token (pairing_tokens collection confirms the previous row is gone). (4) POST /api/bridge/heartbeat with a VALID bridge token (obtained via claim-pairing) and ea_self_check={autotrading:false, ea_trade_allowed:true, webrequest_ok:true, junk:'x'} → 200; account doc stores only the 3 bool flags ('junk' dropped); GET /api/setup/install-progress/{account_id} reports heartbeat step status='warn' with hint mentioning 'AutoTrading'. Sending all three flags true flips the step to status='done'. (5) POST /api/bridge/heartbeat with an invalid bridge token still returns 401 'Invalid bridge token'. Frontend (Playwright, admin@trading.bot, admin_mfa_enforced=false in preview): /accounts shows data-testid=mt5-connection-guide with exactly 5 steps conn-step-1..5; step 3 contains 'QUICK INSTALL' and '60 min'; step 4 has data-testid=conn-server-url; the troubleshoot toggle (mt5-troubleshoot-toggle) expands. Account Quick Install → quick-install-generate-btn issues a token, quick-install-oneliner contains '/api/setup/installer.ps1' and 'Install-Stoic', quick-install-regenerate-btn reads 'NEW CODE', and the copy includes 'Nothing to type in the EA inputs'. /guide renders data-testid=guide-vps-connect-only and NO guide-vps-step-1. /admin/integrations renders the 'Security alerts (Telegram)' card (integration-card-security-telegram) with both integration-key-SECURITY_AGENT_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and integration-key-SECURITY_AGENT_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID rows showing MISSING, and the 'SEND TEST ALERT' button is disabled while not configured. No vault keys set, no Telegram alerts sent, scripts/test_installer.ps1 skipped (no pwsh on this host).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live-preview HTTP suite at /app/tests/test_easy_connect_p1_live.py is self-contained — it reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env or /app/frontend/.env and MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env. All mutating authenticated endpoints need an 'x-csrf-token' header (set from the csrf_token cookie that /api/auth/login writes); the helper _csrf(sess) handles that. Bridge heartbeat auth is via body field bridge_token (not Authorization header), and the payload requires at minimum balance/equity/margin/free_margin/open_positions. Cloudflare occasionally throws a 'Verify you are human' interstitial on fresh browser contexts — a 30-45s wait between flows avoids it.
